From this data, a digital twin of the battery is created by our artificial intelligence, and an estimate of its energy capacity and its autonomy is made, with unparalleled precision.

By then comparing this analysis with the new values ​​of a battery, we offer, in addition to the simple S.O.H, a real health score on a value scale.

This “digital twin” also makes it possible to know the evolution of this battery in the future.
